units.source_text: 上课时间相同的时候，我们一起出门，赶巧的话，放学也一起回家。

en.t: When our class times were the same, we left the house together, and if things worked out, we came home together after school as well.

units.source_text: 从表面上看，K和我又像以前那样亲密无间了。

en.t: Seen from the outside, K and I seemed to be as close as we had been before.

units.source_text: 但是毫无疑问，各人心里都有着各自的打算。

en.t: But there was no doubt that each of us was making his own calculations in his heart.

units.source_text: 有一天，我在路上突然问了K几个问题。

en.t: One day, while we were on the road, I suddenly asked K several questions.

units.source_text: 我先问的是他前几天的告白，是只对我一个人说的，还是也对夫人和小姐说了。

en.t: The first thing I asked was whether his confession a few days earlier had been made only to me, or whether he had also told Madam and the young lady.

units.source_text: 因为我觉得，我今后要采取的做法，取决于他对这个问题的回答。

en.t: For I felt that the course I should take from then on depended on his answer to that question.

units.source_text: 这时，他明白地告诉我，除了我之外，没有对任何人说过。

en.t: At that point, he told me plainly that he had not spoken of it to anyone besides me.

units.source_text: 我暗自高兴，事情跟我预料的一样。

en.t: I was secretly pleased, because matters were just as I had expected.

units.source_text: 我很清楚，K比我要霸道，而且胆量也在我之上，但另一方面，我又莫名地相信他。

en.t: I knew very well that K was more forceful than I was, and that his courage surpassed mine, but on the other hand I also trusted him for reasons I could not explain.

units.source_text: 虽然在学费问题上，他欺骗了养父三年之久，可是我对他的信任却没有受到丝毫影响，反而因此更加相信他了。

en.t: Although he had deceived his adoptive father for three years over the matter of his school expenses, my trust in him had not been affected in the slightest; on the contrary, it made me trust him all the more.

units.source_text: 所以，尽管我这个人疑心很重，却怎么也无法怀疑他这一明确的回答。

en.t: Therefore, suspicious as I was by nature, I simply could not doubt this clear answer of his.
